from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d1c042c7.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The grid is divided into square-ish panels by full-width and full-height lines.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0 and all(x == row[0] for x in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(rbounds[i] + 1, rbounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rbounds) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(cbounds[i] + 1, cbounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cbounds) - 1)]

    def panel(rspan, cspan):
        r0, r1 = rspan; c0, c1 = cspan
        return [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]

    # A non-key panel contains the motif; retain its zero/nonzero mask.
    motif = None
    for ri, rs in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, cs in enumerate(col_spans[1:], start=1):
            p = panel(rs, cs)
            if any(v != 0 for row in p for v in row):
                motif = [[v != 0 for v in row] for row in p]
                break
        if motif is not None:
            break
    if motif is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs in row_spans:
        key_panel = panel(rs, col_spans[0])
        counts = {}
        for row in key_panel:
            for v in row:
                if v != 0:
                    counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
        color = max(counts, key=counts.get)
        for cs in col_spans:
            r0, r1 = rs; c0, c1 = cs
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = color if motif[dr][dc] else 0
    return out
'''
